items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: it was with Red Tyler. On the Rounder label. Red Tyler was one of those musicians that was in my living room in the forties.

ctx.x: That’s a great moment there. I mean everybody’s in the moment and they’re listening to you and reacting to you.
Yeah, it’s funny man, about that particular, that was the title of the album, I forgot the name of the album, it was with Red Tyler.
